## __`OVERVIEW`__
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.
To protect your game data, we ask that you link your account.

## __`ACCOUNT LINKING`__

By linking your account, you can easily restore and transfer your game data even if you accidentally delete the app.
Additionally, if your current device malfunctions or if you wish to change devices, you can transfer your player data to the new device.

## __`HOW TO LINK YOUR ACCOUNT`__
You can link your account to your Apple Account or Google Account.
Steps to Link Account:

1. Select the global menu from the top right of the Home screen.
2. From the Menu (≡) on the top left of the screen, select Account Linking.
*Account Linking is not possible via "Data Transfer" on the title screen.
3. On the Confirm Link screen, you can choose to "Sign in with Apple" or "Sign in with Google."
4. Sign in with your selected account.

After signing in, the message "Account linking complete" will appear upon successful linking.
*Please keep your linked account information secure and avoid sharing it with others.
*After account linking is complete, a confirmation email will be automatically sent to the email address associated with the linked account.

## __`FAQ: REGARDING ACCOUNT LINKING`__
Q1: How do I restore my data or transfer my account?A1: Access Title Menu (≡) on the title screen, select Data Transfer and follow the on-screen instructions.

Q2: After transferring account, will I be able to pick up my game progress from when I linked my account?A2: You can proceed with the game from when you were last online. For example, if you link your account when a mission is ongoing and transfer your account after clearing the mission, the game will proceed from the time when the mission is cleared.

Q3: After transferring my account to a different device, can I still play on the original device?A3: Yes, you can play on both devices. However, you cannot log in to the same account on both devices simultaneously. If a new login is detected on a device, you will be returned to the title screen on the previous device.

Q4: Will my linked account be unlinked if I delete my player data?A4: No, deleting your player data will not unlink your account. To unlink an account, go to Menu (≡) > Account Linking.

Q5: I wish to change my linked account.A5: To do so, first unlink your current account via Menu (≡) > Account Linking. You will then be able to link a new account.

## __`OVERVIEW`__
Kaiju Rush has come online as of <t:1784170800>.
In Kaiju Rush, you will fight against Kaiju while carrying over elements such as HP and SP from battle to battle.
Utilize Support Effects, challenge the Kaiju, and clear quests to earn rewards!

### __`AVAILABILITY PERIOD`__
<t:1784170800> - <t:1785380399>

## __`ELIGIBILITY`__
Reach Spec-Ops Rank 2 or higher.

## __`EVENT DESCRIPTION`__
- In Kaiju Rush, you will take on consecutive battles with a single squad while carrying over elements such as HP and SP from battle to battle.
- Kaiju Rush does not require Stamina to challenge.
- In between battles, you can select a Strategy Card. Strategy Cards have various effects, such as Buff and Recovery. They will play an important role during your challenge.
- Additionally, the Strategy Card you selected will affect your Rush Score from winning the battle.
- Powerful "Designated Kaiju" appear during the rush or in the final battle. Defeating them grants a large score.

- By achieving exclusive Kaiju Rush missions, you can earn various rewards.
- Kaiju Rush is divided into multiple areas, each with 4 difficulties. If you clear a higher difficulty with the maximum Rush Score, all quests on lower difficulties will automatically be considered cleared with a max score, with all the Designated Kaiju battles considered won.
- During the event period, the areas that can be challenged will unlock every two days.

## __`STRATEGY CARDS`__
- In Kaiju Rush, you can select one Strategy Card after each battle.

- The score indicated on a Strategy Card is added to your cumulative Rush Score upon selection.
- There are two types of Strategy Cards: cards with Buff/Recovery effects that give you an edge in the battles, and cards with Debuff effects that put you at a disadvantage.
- Cards with Buff/Recovery effects provide a smaller score increase, while cards with Debuff effects provide a larger score increase.
- Incapacitated characters cannot participate in the next battle. However, if you select a Strategy Card with an HP Recovery effect, they can rejoin the fight in the next battle.

## __`SUPPORT EFFECTS`__

- Each area in Kaiju Rush has different Support Effects you can obtain.
- Make full use of these Support Effects to gain an advantage in neutralizing Kaiju.

## __`MISSIONS`__
- There are 2 types of missions in Kaiju Rush.

▽ Rush Score Missions
- Earn rewards based on your total cumulative score from all areas.
- A total of 800 Dimensional Crystals can be earned by clearing all stages (up to HARD difficulty) in all areas with the maximum score.

▽ Designated Kaiju Battle Win Count Missions
- Earn rewards based on your Designated Kaiju battle win count. (*The win count is only increased upon your first victory against the Designated Kaiju. Multiple victories in the same Designated Kaiju battle will not increase the win count.)

- A total of 800 Dimensional Crystals can be earned by winning all Designated Kaiju battles (up to HARD difficulty) in all areas.

- For more details about the missions, please head to Kaiju Rush > Rush Missions.

## __`AREA UNLOCK DATES`__
- Area 1

<t:1784689200>

## __`IMPORTANT`__
- Once the event ends, Kaiju Rush rewards will no longer be available (and will not be sent to your Mail). Please remember to claim them within the event period.
- On the Strategy Card selection screen, you can choose to suspend your current Kaiju Rush run, and resume the quest afterward by pressing the "In Progress" button.
- Suspended battle data is held for 12 hours. Please be aware that if this time limit is exceeded, your current quest progress and score will be discarded.
- When the quest ends (whether by clearing or upon defeat), the Rush Score you have earned up to that point will be saved.

## __`MAIN STORY CHAPTER 13 RELEASE`__
Thank you for playing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME.

Main Story Chapter 13 "The Seven Dimensional Gates" is now available as of <t:1783652400>.

Head to Home > Story and select Main Story Chapter 13 to experience it.
While you can play the content even if you have not cleared the previous Main Story chapters, we recommend clearing up to Chapter 12 first.

In addition, you can obtain a special Home background upon clearing Main Story Chapter 13.

## __`NEW CHAPTER EVENT`__

To celebrate the release of Main Story Chapter 13, the New Chapter Event is now available.
Take part in the event from Home > Events > New Chapter Event after clearing Main Story Chapter 0.

### __`AVAILABILITY PERIOD`__
<t:1783652400> - <t:1785553199>

Progress through Main Story Chapter 13 and challenge the score battles to earn rewards such as Dimensional Crystals.

■ Score Battle
During the event, you can challenge score battles of varying difficulties.
These battles do not consume Stamina and are unlocked by progressing through the new Main Story chapter.

Please check the event screen for the specific unlock conditions for each difficulty.

For the score battles in this event, your performance is evaluated and scored based on the following three criteria:
・Number of rounds elapsed at victory
・Total DMG taken until victory
・Max DMG in a single attack

Scores are ranked from C, B, A, to S. (No score will be awarded for a defeat.)
Your current highest score can be viewed on the event screen. For reference on further increasing your scores, please check the breakdown for each criterion on the Result screen.

There are two types of rewards related to score battles: first-clear rewards and mission rewards, which are earned by achieving a certain score.

■ Stage Effects

The New Chapter Event features unique stage effects.
